resolutions: After LEAN-WORKFLOW ships, the approval-bound artifact records design_review required/routine in existing frontmatter. Missing/unknown means required; the named sensitive-change triggers require design scrutiny and routine classification needs a no-trigger rationale. Workers cannot downgrade it. Both adapters use the same predicate. One actual assessment may cover several applicable gates only with complete reviewed inputs and independent existing digest bindings. The first task retains all current gates until changed enforcement ships; no current pass is fabricated from this future rule.

Accepted 0064 explicitly amends the obsolete fixed-cap interpretation of 0058. The specification defines existing review limits as the installed helpers actual safeguards and complete lossless coverage, not a pinned 512000-byte Forge limit. Measure complete final inputs, use supported chunks and split if intact input cannot fit; no helper cap is edited or overridden. This implements the users already approved simplification while preserving the roadmap criterion.

The specification restores approved story, matching decomposition, exact story/task identity, fetched trunk commit and all effective dependency markers; open PR, green CI and messages are explicitly insufficient. It preserves fixed IDs/order/dependencies and the existing clean, unowned, same-common-directory attachment and publish-owner-last requirements under 0059.

The specification names main-launched forge review under accepted 0011/0064, prohibits self-certification and nested reviewers, and requires delegated fixes followed by review until every assessment is clean. Proposed 0049 is explicitly not authority. First uses current three-lens execution; LEAN later implements one combined operation with genuine linked lens artifacts.

The specification retains factory/schemas/test-automated.json, implementer production, the existing recorder/task path and six fixed labels. The specification names scoped and legacy events.bundle.json paths, format forge-event-bundle/v1, matching story/explicit IDs, validated reader union and identical-ID deduplication during interrupted cleanup. Conflicts refuse; legacy idless history stays unchanged and unread as new live events. After shipped proof is durable, sibling temporary write plus atomic replacement precedes read-back exact comparison and source removal. Failure preserves loose sources and hard proof.

The specification names the existing committed native-foreground-preparation-inventory.json, exact824baed4 baseline, 109953-byte bee122 patch and16 prepared-file hashes. It requires the complete versioned lean-delivery graph and reproducible artifacts to allocate all original paths/hunks and be SHA-bound by the approved story plan before any support-task contract. Main is publishing that graph and exact patches before plan approval; the spec does not treat temporary paths or source approvals as target authority.

The saved specification now maps all six gates to their exact existing classification input, record and digest. Epics derives classification from linked capability specs rather than adding JSON authority; signoff includes its complete located handover. Classification/rationale stay authored and digest-bound. A shared read explicitly names every gate, includes complete located/grounding inputs, returns independently assessed frontiers and binds each existing record; current one-gate launches cannot claim this future capability. LEAN owns implementation and refusal regressions before the feature is usable.

The checkpoint now names normal Git/gh draft operations instead of forge task pr-ready, matches origin/head repository/head branch/base/reviewed commit, refuses creation after uncertain or ambiguous lookup, and re-queries after uncertain creation. It preserves one PR identity and eventual marker identity/timestamp. Shared owns the retry mechanism and Integration its live checkpoint; no new registry or authority is introduced.
